name: Cape Cod
agency: NOAA / National Centers for Environmental Information
note: Nearby Hyannis station USC00193821 is 0.64 km from the unchanged reference point, but its weakest calendar-month coverage is 74.73% for paired temperatures and 73.33% for precipitation. Both fail the existing 80% baseline-day requirement.

name: Cancún
note: Station 23155, Cancún, is 3.10 km away and 3 m lower. Official dated daily observations pass the unchanged policy for both variables; minimum monthly coverage is 93.01% for temperature and 89.98% for precipitation. NULO values are excluded. The archive supplies no per-record QC flags.

name: Mexico City
note: Station 09048, Tacubaya Central, is 7.53 km away and 70.6 m higher. Official dated daily observations pass the unchanged policy for both variables; minimum monthly coverage is 86.67% for temperature and 90.00% for precipitation. NULO values are excluded. The archive supplies no per-record QC flags.

name: San José
note: IMN explicitly directs detailed station-data requests through its services form. Its current instructions describe a follow-up letter or quotation for non-academic requests. No request was submitted, and a qualifying 1991–2020 station export has not been audited.

name: Havana
note: The official INSMET portal and its climate/report links were checked. A dated daily 1991–2020 station archive and its access procedure were not verified; this does not establish that a request or account is required.

name: Aruba
note: The agency publishes 1991–2020 normals and annual climate summaries. The inspected 1991 file contains monthly averages and rain-day counts, not individual daily readings, so it cannot support the temperature-range scoring distribution. A historical daily export remains unverified.

name: Cartagena
note: IDEAM documents its DHIME citizen portal for station-data consultation and download. The portal returned an unsupported-browser page during this pass; no dated Cartagena export, approval-level flags or baseline coverage were verified. No account requirement is inferred from that rendering failure.

name: Galápagos
note: Puerto Ayora's operator-published daily CSV is from a station 0.92 km away and 9 m lower. All 2020 minimum temperatures are excluded because the operator warns of 2020–2021 instrument errors. Both variables still pass the unchanged policy: minimum monthly coverage 86.33% temperature and 96.67% precipitation. No per-record QC flags are supplied. Source and derived monthly summaries are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: attribution, noncommercial use and share-alike terms apply.

name: Cusco
note: SENAMHI exposes a historical station-download map and a separate registration workflow requesting identity and emailed credentials. A qualifying Cusco station export and whether that workflow is currently mandatory for the export were not verified; no station record was imported.

name: Rio de Janeiro
note: INMET's BDMEP conventional-station archive explicitly requires an email request, confirmation link, and subsequent download link sent by email. The immediate annual automatic-station ZIP route starts in 2000 and cannot supply the required 1991–2000 decade coverage by itself. No email request was submitted.

name: Buenos Aires
note: SMN's public open-data page links a complete daily 1991–2020 archive, but fetching the linked RAR returned HTTP 403 in this pass. The archive's station coordinates, missing/QC conventions and daily coverage have not been audited. This retrieval failure is not evidence of an account or payment requirement. A browser attempt also stopped at Cloudflare security verification without reaching the archive; no challenge was solved or bypassed, and no account or payment requirement is inferred.

name: Patagonia
note: SMN's public open-data page links a daily 1991–2020 archive, but its RAR returned HTTP 403 in this pass. Coverage and a station within 15 km / 150 m of the existing El Calafate-area reference point remain unverified. The reference point was not moved to an airport or another Patagonian location. A browser attempt also stopped at Cloudflare security verification without reaching the archive; no challenge was solved or bypassed, and no account or payment requirement is inferred.

name: Goa
note: IMD's Data Supply Portal explicitly requires account registration, email verification and identity/undertaking documentation, followed by an online data request and any applicable charges. No account or request was created. Station representativeness still needs verification against the unchanged inland Goa reference point.

name: Delhi
note: IMD's Data Supply Portal explicitly requires account registration, email verification and identity/undertaking documentation, followed by an online data request and any applicable charges. No account or request was created; no qualifying 1991–2020 daily station export has been audited.

name: Kathmandu
note: DHM publishes a meteorological data request form, procurement process, price schedule and payment procedure for historical observations. No request or payment was made. Daily station values, missing-data flags and baseline coverage remain unaudited.

name: Colombo
note: The meteorological-service portal could not be retrieved in this pass. The official Department of Agriculture also has a meteorological-data request page, but it does not verify a Colombo station or a 1991–2020 daily export. No account, fee or mandatory request is inferred from these incomplete checks.

name: Maldives
note: The current agency form explicitly offers daily maximum/minimum temperature and rainfall as raw CSV, with identity/contact details and a reason for requesting data. It warns that another island's data may be substituted when the requested island is unavailable; any returned station must still pass the existing distance/elevation screen. No request was submitted.

name: Queenstown
note: NIWA lists Queenstown station 5446 at −45.03476, 168.66364 and 322 m, close to the unchanged reference point, with a long historical daily record. The actual station-file page requires login to view purchase options. Public metadata alone does not establish valid daily values, licensing or 1991–2020 completeness.
